# Little Hero Books: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-18 · code 6953099e76cb · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Design a cartoon look-alike of your child, then read, colour, paint or print fairy tales starring them, or write your own. Eighteen stories for ages 3 to 6.
**Live:** https://littleheroapp.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/little-hero-books · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/littleherobooks/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py littleherobooks` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Paint this book** (2026-11-08): `server_code/Painting.py` talks to Image Enhancer (the user's own service, repo
  image-enhancer) through `server_code/enhancer_client.py` (a copy of that repo's `clients/enhancer_client.py`: keep them
  the same). Setup = App Secrets `image_enhancer_key` + `image_enhancer_webhook_secret` (+ optional `image_enhancer_url`),
  or the address in Admin -> Painting. End-to-end test: `tools/testing/paint_e2e.py` (see the guide's "Paint this book").
- Anvil forms have a built-in `self.style` (CSS): never use it as your own attribute (Dialogs/Paint uses `self.chosen`).
- **Kept for the visit + Full screen** (2026-11-10): `LH.media` in `theme/assets/lh-book.js` keeps painted pictures and
  recordings in memory (blob: URLs) so nothing downloads twice; the reader's `setFull()` + "Full screen reading" in
  app.css. Details in the guide's "Record my voice" section.
- **Write your own story** (2026-11-17): `server_code/UserStories.py` + table `user_stories`; written stories borrow
  library pictures by reference ("bears:3"), and `LH.sceneSvg` accepts a story object (`LH.picRef`), so lh-book.js
  passes the story, not its key. Details in the guide's "More stories + Write your own".
<!-- /NOTES -->

- **saved_paintings**: book→books, page:num, style:str, look:str, picture:media, created:dt · used in Painting
- **user_stories**: owner→users, key:str, title:str, blurb:str, color:str, cover:str, pages:obj, base:str, created:dt, updated:dt · used in UserStories
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, display_name:str, is_admin:bool, is_demo:bool, last_seen:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str, remembered_logins:obj · used in Admin, DemoData
- **voice_pages**: book→books, page:num, audio:media, seconds:num, key:str, created:dt · used in Voice

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/paint_previews.py`: Repaint the style samples in the Paint dialog (theme/assets/paint-<style>.jpg + paint-drawing.jpg).
- `tools/session_test.py`: Expired-session test: the app must reload quietly (same page, still signed in, typed text kept) ins…
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
